title: Depositing More Should Not Earn Less: Supplier Income Monotonicity and Rate Curve Design in Pooled Lending Markets
abstract: arXiv:2610.36899v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In utilization dependent interest rate models, adding liquidity can reduce a supplier's total interest income even as the supplier's balance increases. A supplier holding a fraction $\alpha$ of final pool supply keeps income nondecreasing with a marginal deposit exactly when $\alpha(1+\eta)\leq1$, where $\eta$ is the elasticity of the borrow rate with respect to utilization. When the condition fails, the supplier can instead raise its income by withdrawing, which pushes utilization further up. On two public Drift markets, a lender held more of the pool than the curve protected in at least one hour in nine on SOL and one in thirteen on USDC. A protocol turns this into a design constraint by choosing, at each utilization, the largest supplier share it intends to protect. That choice caps the elasticity, and integrating the cap describes every admissible curve. Protecting the same share at every utilization gives a power law boundary, and p

translated_title: 存入更多不应赚得更少：池化借贷市场中的供应方收入单调性与利率曲线设计
translated_abstract: 在依赖资金利用率的利率模型中，即使供应方的余额增加，添加流动性也可能降低供应方的总利息收入。当且仅当持有最终池供应量份额 α 的供应方满足 α(1+η)≤1 时，其边际存款才能保持收入不减少，其中 η 是借款利率对资金利用率的弹性。当该条件不成立时，供应方反而可以通过提款来提高收入，而这会进一步推高资金利用率。在两个公开的 Drift 市场上，SOL 市场中至少有九分之一的小时、USDC 市场中至少有十三分之一的小时，出现了放贷人持有的池内份额超过曲线所保护水平的情况。协议可以将这一点转化为设计约束：在每一资金利用率下，选择其打算保护的最大供应方份额。这一选择为弹性设定了上限，对该上限进行积分即可刻画所有可接受的利率曲线。若在每个利用率下保护相同的份额，则会得到一个幂律边界，并……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文给出了池化借贷市场中供应方收入随存款增加而不减少的充要条件 α(1+η)≤1，并提出通过在每一资金利用率下设定受保护的最大供应方份额来约束借款利率弹性，从而设计出可避免“存入更多反而赚得更少”的利率曲线。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the necessary and sufficient condition α(1+η)≤1 for supplier income monotonicity in pooled lending markets, and shows that protocols can design admissible rate curves by capping borrow-rate elasticity to protect a chosen maximum supplier share at every utilization level, thereby preventing suppliers from earning less by depositing more.
